boardProfile.layout: Blok Out Level 50 is the directional slider finale — no bosslar, no sayaçlar, no cihazlar. Tall ok bloklar packed içine three sütunlar can only kaydır in the yön their ok points: blue ve yellow çubuklar go up, green bloklar go down, red çubuklar go sola or sağa, ve purple iticiler doldur the kenarlar. landmarks: Blok Out Level 50 is the directional slider finale — no bosslar, no sayaçlar, no cihazlar.

Tall ok bloklar packed içine three sütunlar can only kaydır in the yön their ok points: blue ve yellow çubuklar go up, green bloklar go down, red çubuklar go sola or sağa, ve purple iticiler doldur the kenarlar.

The solve is about rota order: free one dikey şerit first, use the red yatay çubuklar as trafik denetleyiciler (not engeller), ve save the green ve purple parçalar for after the big çubuklar have temizlendi.

quickTips: The red yatay çubuklar are trafik denetleyiciler, not engeller — keep one in reserve until the verticals are mostly gone.
Free one long dikey şerit first. Do not temizle both red çubuklar immediately.
Think in chain temizler. The best hareket is the one that sets up the next two hareketler, not just the quickest current eşleştir.

steps.title: Hamle 1
steps.instruction: Free the first long dikey şerit by kaydıran one blue or yellow çubuk up ve out.

steps.title: Hamle 2
steps.instruction: Use that opened şerit to shift another yellow or blue ok blok out of the yığın.

steps.title: Hamle 3
steps.instruction: Keep the sağa side from overfilling while the first red yatay çubuk kaydırır out.

steps.title: Hamle 4
steps.instruction: Open the second long şerit only after the first side is calmer.

steps.title: Hamle 5
steps.instruction: Serbest bırak the green down-ok bloklar after the dikey engelleyiciler are thinner.

steps.title: Hamle 6
steps.instruction: Use the purple push bloklar late, once the big çubuklar are already gone.

steps.title: Hamle 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the last red or green parça after the room is mostly empty.

failurePoints: Removing both red yatay çubuklar before the dikey şeritler are ready — this removes your trafik control ve the sağa side overfills.
Trying to kaydır a green down-ok blok before the dikey çubuklar above it have temizlendi, which jams the sütun.
